It’s like adding inspectors at the end of the process to see if it’s gone well—extra work without making anything better.

paragraphs.source_en: The quartermasters who prepared the charts knew we would end up in the Maui basin, but they didn’t know which of the three paths we’d take to get there: north of Molokai, between Molokai and Lanai, or south of Lanai. They plotted the navigationally better route, which was north of Molokai. This was open water and the fastest route, but it wasn’t the way the enemy submarine would go and, hence, wasn’t the way we needed to go.
